semantic.justification: SwASCWriter retains native SwPaM selection output and now serializes full body text and table rows through the Writer shell. Full-document output preserves original numbering and final line rules; WriteTable follows upstream tab-separated cells, intra-cell paragraph breaks and row terminators. Complete ASCII attributes/fields/redlines, clipboard table topology, rings/options, desktop environment overrides and broad core/UI parity remain unverified.
